items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 78:1
items.html: (To the question) Leah is the aspect of the Achoraim of Ima, which were nullified from the heads of Aba and Ima at the time of the diminishment of the moon, and fell to the place of the Nukva of the body, as is known. Therefore she was corrected in Atzilut to be the aspect of the Nukva for ZA, and she receives from his Mochin and is corrected with him. And it is found that Leah is a higher degree than ZA, from her source, and she is truly the aspect of the head of ZA, for Ima is the head of ZA. Therefore, after ZA received the aspect of Neshama, she ascends by him to the aspect of his GAR, namely from the chest and above, and receives from him the GAR equally with the Nukva in the body of ZA, which is from the chest and above. But Rachel, who is the separate Nukva of ZA, is only an offshoot of ZA, and her source is in the Gadlut of Nekudim, after his NHY from BYA joined to him, as above in Answer 206, when a building of the lower nine was made for her from those NHY of the Gadlut. It is thus found that the whole root of Rachel is only in the NHY of ZA, and she has no share from the chest and above of ZA; therefore she was corrected only from the chest and below of ZA, like the Nukva in the body of ZA, which is from his chest and below. (Item 152 and in the Inner Light, s.v. indeed).
